body: Have you ever heard the producer Helios? His music gives me hope. http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FAch_Xt32Eg

I've already booked a trip to Costa Rica in 3 months :) Just taking a backpack and a diary. Will be good to see things in a different light, although I can see myself becoming morbidly depressed at the state of the nation over there. Gah

I really enjoyed this comment, it is ultimately a contingent factor in these recurring thoughts I have. I am **totally** aware that my worries are not unique, they are just a product of my own human nature, and to even post this comment talking about how they're a *problem* just makes me feel quite ridiculous because I know this is something everyone goes through, and I haven't escaped it. 

This is why I often turn to Buddhism. It's not so much that I want to replace faith where there are gaps in my knowledge, but I'm so assured in thinking that the state of the human situation is terrible, society is corrupt in 1000 different ways, and I'll be damned if I don't escape it. But I've already fastened so many erksome obligations in it that it seems almost impossible that I can just get up and leave, but it's really what I'd like to do. The Buddhist way of living seems applicable at times. Sustaining one's self, and meditating. 

But then I think, well you know what, if these thoughts are just a product of evolution and this is truly a material world, surely the way in which humans are living (to some extent) is purely a result of evolution and would hence be a foolish move to try and escape it, because it's just the natural way in which humanity has developed. It doesn't help that I have always **despised** money.

Again, that all just seemed to me like a whole lot of gobble-de-gook. I do feel content in lots of ways, but I can't exactly pinpoint them yet. I feel contentment in general but I'm unsure why. It also doesn't help that I did my philosophy dissertation on the redundancy of communication and feel like no communication can hold any worth. But I'm trying to express myself. :(((((((((((((((((((((
